THE LEARNING SHELF

Useful resources.
A clearer next step.

A focused collection of official tutorials and documentation for learning AI, computer vision, and VR. Choose a small goal, work through one resource, and build something with what you learn.

Start with one track

For machine learning, work on Python and core concepts before moving to models. For VR, take a separate route through interactive development. You do not need to learn every framework at once.

PythonMachine learningComputer visionDeep learningVirtual reality

Turn a tutorial into a project

  1. Run the original example before changing it.
  2. Change one input, parameter, or feature and predict what will happen.
  3. Record the result, including mistakes and limitations.
  4. Explain your approach in a short README with setup instructions.

Need a starting point? Browse the project archive or read the guide to your first computer vision project.
